# Salamander Grand Piano V3

The piano samples in this folder are from the **Salamander Grand Piano V3**,
a Yamaha C5 grand piano sampled by **Alexander Holm**.

- Original: <https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3>
- Licence: **Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0)** —
  <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/>
- This subset (one velocity layer, every minor third from A0 to C8, MP3) is
  the one the Tone.js project hosts at
  <https://github.com/Tonejs/audio/tree/master/salamander>.

The files are unchanged. `tools/fetch-grand-piano.sh` fetches them again;
`build.js` embeds them in `index.html`, and the app credits the piano where it
is played (the ⋯ options of every score's play bar, and Settings → Sound).
